name: lif-theme
description: Draws your prompts and Claude's replies in padded, coloured boxes with reply markdown in the theme's colours. Three themes, switched in /config or with /lif-theme, and one setting turns it all off.

enabled.title: Themed messages
enabled.description: Off: prompts and replies are drawn by Claude Code itself, as if the plugin were not installed.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: claude-warm: terracotta prompts, charcoal replies. night-blue: navy prompts, near-black replies. titanium: steel blue prompts, grey replies.
